messages:
Laura: Quick check — CI error applying tenant namespace TF change: pods in telemetry namespace can't assume role. PR #482 moved IRSA annotation into the namespace-level helm values instead of the ServiceAccount resource. Anyone know if that's intended? @Miguel

Miguel: That was my change, sorry. I moved it to namespace metadata to keep the helm chart DRY across services. I thought projected SA tokens would still pick it up. Looks like I missed that the k8s controller (and IRSA mapping) requires the annotation on the ServiceAccount.

Aditi: We should avoid namespace-scoped annotations for IRSA afaik. AWS docs show `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` must be on the SA (or use a mutating controller). Can you paste the TF/helm snippet? Also we should check terraform state drift and whether the SA resource will be managed by the chart or terraform.

Miguel: snippet:
```
# helm values
serviceAccount:
  create: true
  annotations: {}
namespaceAnnotations:
  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-role
```

Miguel: in terraform we had the namespace created separate from the chart and I added the annotation there instead of the SA.

Chris: quick CR ping @Miguel — if we move the annotation back to the SA, do we need a migration step to update existing SAs? Also projected token mount paths might be different depending on kube version.

Miguel: Reapplying the SA manifest will update the annotation without re-creating the SA. Pods need restart to pick up new projected tokens. For terraform, if we keep namespace annotation we might end up with drift in state — suggest move the annotation into the helm values for `serviceAccount.annotations` and remove it from the standalone namespace resource in TF.

deploy-bot: CI apply failed in telemetry namespace: Error from server (BadRequest): invalid annotation `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` on Namespace

Laura: Plan: Miguel updates PR to add `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` back on the ServiceAccount via helm values, remove it from the TF namespace resource, and add a post-apply job to restart deployments in telemetry (`kubectl rollout restart`). Also run `terraform plan` against the state to ensure no leftover drift. @Aditi ok?

Aditi: :+1: add a note in the PR description about pod restart requirements and link to the AWS IRSA docs.

Miguel: On it — will push a small fix in ~30m and tag for review. Ref: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html

Chris: :eyes: will review the PR once it's up.
